minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, February 22, 2024
  6:30 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  February 22, 2024 / 6:30 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Mayor Julian Gold, Vice Mayor Lester Friedman, Deputy City Manager
  Keith Sterling, NEXT Beverly Hills Committee Chair Charles Smith

  1) Public Comment:
  a. A resident wanted to know if a Beverly Hills investor dinner that he had been
  receiving several notifications about was a city event due to them using the Beverly
  Hills sign. It was not a city event, and the mayor reiterated that the sign and the
  words “Beverly Hills” are not protected and can be used by non-city actors.

  2) Welcome & Introductions:
  a. Dana Brothman: was invited by Charles to give some ideas to the committee.
  b. Noel Corbyn: resident
  c. Craig Corman: resident
  d. Elyssia Payne: resident
  e. Samantha Dornfeld: observer for Neighborhood Forward
  f. Daniel DiCriscio: has attended these meetings for over a year and has worked in
  the city for around 30 years.

  3) NEXT Beverly Hills Mission Statement:
  a. NEXT Beverly Hills is a committee of talented next generation leaders focused on
  innovative initiatives which address lifestyle, economic, and civic needs of those in
  their 20s, 30s, and 40s chartered by the mayor and the city of Beverly Hills that
  seeks to engage all that are interested to inspire them and to make Beverly Hills a
  better place for all.

  4) New Business:
  a. Recap of the Charity Drive:
  i. There were some coordination issues with kindness week and the charity
  drive, but they were resolved prior to the drive itself, which occurred without
  any problems.
  ii. The drive received donations of several blankets and jackets.
 Highlights for February 22, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  b. Allison will be stepping down from her role as sustainability chair. She has been
  with NEXT for 7 years and is stepping down to focus on her primary business.
  c. Due to the coordination issues encountered between the Charity Drive and
  Kindness Week, a a copy of the city editorial calendar will be attached to every
  future NEXT agenda to prevent scheduling conflicts.
  d. NEXT is in the process of selecting a venue for an open house, which will most
  likely take place towards the end of Q1 of FY 2024-2025.
  i. Current issues are that the food/drink minimums for the venues are slightly
  higher than what is available in the budget.
  e. The Mayor and Vice Mayor reminded everyone watching and attending the
  meeting to vote in the upcoming election.
  f. The City Council Liaison also remined everyone in attendance to look at your state
  legislators and know who they are and what they stand for in order to make an
  informed decision.
  g. The Liaisons also described what would happen should the city’s housing element
  not be approved, in which case state courts could potentially have the ability to
  strip the permitting abilities of the city depending on the results of a case making
  its way through the courts.
  h. The installation for the new City Councilmembers will be on April 2nd. It will be a
  business casual event at the Wallace Annenberg Center for the Performing Arts.
  There will be food provided and admission is free.
  i. Construction on the Vanity Fair Oscar Party venue on 400 N Crescent will begin
  next week and the street will be blocked off for the next couple of weeks.
  j. Merv Griffon Way, which is the cut through road next to the Beverly Hilton, will be
  closed for the next four years due to One Beverly Hills construction.

  5) Current Business:
  a. Next Night
  i. Next Night takes around a year to plan.
  ii. The primary demographic of people who attend are couples with small
  children.
  iii. Proposal for a questionnaire of icebreakers to be handed out at the event.
  iv. Proposal for a smaller food and wine festival in June that would be oriented
  towards a more adult demographic with a capacity of around 1,000 to 1,500
  rather than Next Night’s 5,000.
  v. A number of South Beverly Businesses are in support of a night market,
  that either is a part of or independent from Next Night as an alternative to
  the food trucks.
  vi. The liaisons have indicated that charging an admittance fee for an event
  on the street of South Beverly is not possible due to the cost of setting up
  the ticketing infrastructure costing more than the revenue it would generate.
  This is based on past council experiences with a proposal to do so for the
  Concours d’Elegance.
  b. The opera proposition is still being discussed with city staff. It would be towards
  the end of the year, during either fall or winter. The venue is still up in the air and
 Highlights for February 22, 2024
NEXT Beverly Hills Committee

  discussions have been had around it being a charity gala event. Further planning
  would have to be done with Stephanie Harris.

  6) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: February 22, 2024 / 7:32 PM
